curatedMovie.curiosityHook: As the hostile town turns on Paul, what grotesque truth hides behind Imboca's devotion to the monstrous sea god Dagon?
curatedMovie.description: Stranded after a boating accident off the Spanish coast, Paul and his girlfriend seek help in decrepit Imboca, only to find people vanishing as the night gives way to inhuman horrors.
curatedMovie.vibeSummary: Fast, suspenseful creature horror with moderate emotional weight, ideal for an engaged late-night watch alone.
curatedMovie.whyWatch: Stuart Gordon delivers a relentless, fast-paced horror thriller where coastal gothic dread collides with bizarre sea-god mythology and desperate, running survival.
